_comment: Generic post-fix watch rules (AKKIA-28, docs/grafana-alerting.md). Not a provisioning file:
scripts/grafana_dispatch.py renders them into the rule group akkiabot-watch from the watch list
(issue metadata), replacing __ENVS__ / __HANDLERS__ / __COMMANDS__ with regexes of the watched
targets, so only watched handlers / commands can ever fire. With no watch the group is deleted.
Datasource uids prometheus / loki are swapped for the stack's own, like grafana_sync.py does.

regression.title: 修复后观察：handler 失败（复发信号）

model.expr: sum by (env, handler) (count_over_time({service="app", env=~`__ENVS__`} |= `handler failed` | handler=~`__HANDLERS__` [10m]))

annotations.summary: 被观察的 handler 在 10 分钟内记录了 handler failed 日志（Loki 计数，不受容器重启时计数器归零影响）

exercised.title: 修复后观察：命令成功执行（自然事件）

model.expr: (sum by (env, command) (increase(akkiabot_command_total{result="ok", env=~`__ENVS__`, command=~`__COMMANDS__`}[1h])) > 0) or sum by (env, command) (akkiabot_command_total{result="ok", env=~`__ENVS__`, command=~`__COMMANDS__`} unless akkiabot_command_total{result="ok", env=~`__ENVS__`, command=~`__COMMANDS__`} offset 1h)

annotations.summary: 被观察的命令在最近 1 小时内成功执行过（含容器重启后新出现的序列）
